MutationContext.description: Metadata every mutation must carry so retries and stale edits are safe.

description: Request payload for the `project.update` command: the settings an operator owns after registration. The code, the target repository, and the Seed Workspace are absent on purpose — they are not correctable facts but the anchors every recorded Plan, Spec, Ticket, Workspace, and landing already hangs from.

herdr_session.description: The Herdr session name, if one is selected; absence selects Herdr's default session.

initiative_id.description: The Initiative the Project sits under, if any.

name.description: The intended name; blank names are refused.

project_id.description: The Project whose settings are changing.

title: ProjectUpdateRequest
